description: An Applied governance item writes only a governance or skill text file (Phase 6 review F1, F2, E1, F4). Every load of decisions.json (here hash --record) refuses, naming the item, a target_file or blast edit whose path has a memory component (v1 the reviewer's probe: the human-attested entry deleted through a blast edit; v5, v8, and v9 a `Memory` component), is not a .md file (v2 the probe's script, v6), has a '..' (v7), lies outside the repositories (v3) or is a .md that is neither the item's target_file nor a hit of its blast output (v4). `memory-notes.md` (v10) is no memory component: it is accepted. `handoff check decisions.json` (the gate, complete) also refuses an Applied item without target_file or new_text and an unplaceable current_text, on the item and on a blast edit, and a track or for_conflict that names nothing.
